howToApply: Visit the Bank’s official website at www.nainitalbank.bank.in and navigate to the Career section under the Recruitment tab.

Proceed to the Payment tab and pay the application fee of Rs. 1500/- (including GST) online using Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards, Mobile Wallets, or UPI.
After successful payment, an e-Receipt will be generated. Take a printout of the e-Receipt and the online application form.
A candidate can apply for only one post. In case of multiple applications, only the latest valid (completed) application will be retained.

Attach a Non-Refundable Demand Draft as application fee (Rs. 2000 for General; Rs. 1000 for OBC/SC/ST/PwD/EWS domiciled in UP; USD 100 or equivalent for overseas candidates) in favor of Director, SGPGIMS, Lucknow Academic Account, payable at SBI Code No. 7789, SGPGIMS, Lucknow. Write your name on the back of the draft.

Attach all required documents: date of birth certificate, address proof, category certificate (OBC within last 6 months), copies of professional degrees, MBBS/MD/MS/DNB/DM/MCh/DrNB registration certificates, teaching experience certificates, prints of research papers published, and testimonials from 3 referees.
Submit 10 copies of the Summary page (pages 4A & 4B).

Superscribe the envelope with ‘Application for faculty position’, mention the advertisement number, and address it to: Executive Registrar, Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences, Raebareli Road, Lucknow 226014, India.
Send the application by Speed Post/Registered Post so as to reach on or before 31st August 2026.

Advance applications are accepted, but a copy forwarded through proper channel or a ‘No Objection Certificate’ from the current employer must be submitted before the interview call or presented on the date of interview.

howToApply: Visit the official website upsssc.gov.in and click on the relevant advertisement under the Live Advertisement Segment on the Homepage.
Login using your PET-2025 Registration Number via OTP sent to your registered mobile number/email.
Verify your personal details auto-populated from PET-2025 registration (name, father/husband name, mother name, category, date of birth, gender, etc.).
Select the post(s) you wish to apply for and fill in educational qualification details including board/university name, year of passing, certificate/roll number, date of issue, and marks obtained.
Enter the verification code and click the Submit button to generate your application with an 11-digit registration number.
Upload/verify photo and signature (auto-populated from PET-2025; no changes allowed).
Fill in preference of posts and preferred qualification details in the ‘Other Details’ section.
Read and accept the Declaration by ticking all checkboxes, enter verification code, and click ‘Save and Submit’.
Pay the application fee via Credit Card/Debit Card/Internet Banking/UPI or SBI e-Challan as per instructions on the website.
After successful fee payment and reconciliation, the application will be auto-submitted. Download and print the application form for future reference.
If needed, modifications can be made till 24-08-2026 via the ‘Modify Application’ option on the Applicant’s Dashboard using OTP verification.
